records.name: Ghosts Ahoy and Ectophial acquisition
records.scope: Current factual quest-completion, Ectophial acquisition, refill, and replacement mechanics for an Ironman. This record does not assess route timing, travel value, combat readiness, or preparation efficiency.

hard_access_gates.explicit_non_requirement: Nature Spirit is not listed as a Ghosts Ahoy prerequisite by the registered current quest source.

Agility.required_for: Crossing the rocks for the shipwreck/map section.

Cooking.required_for: Preparing nettle tea during the Old Crone section.

required_to_hold_or_use.use: Required to communicate with quest ghosts and is presented for the Old Crone enchantment sequence.
required_to_hold_or_use.final_state: The quest uses an enchanted Ghostspeak amulet state; this record does not model it as a separately acquired non-quest reward.

required_to_hold_or_use.use: Combined with the prepared nettle tea for the Old Crone.
required_to_hold_or_use.transition: Consumed or transformed during the tea sequence.

required_to_hold_or_use.use: Repairs the quest-provided model ship with a needle.

required_to_hold_or_use.transition: Tool; not consumed by the stated repair step.

required_to_hold_or_use.use: Used in the model-ship repair step.
required_to_hold_or_use.transition: Tool; not consumed by the stated repair step.

required_to_hold_or_use.use: Digs up the Book of Haricanto on Dragontooth Island.
required_to_hold_or_use.transition: Tool; not consumed by the stated dig step.

required_to_hold_or_use.use: Robin signs it after the Rune-Draw debt is cleared; the resulting signed oak bow is traded to Ak-Haranu for the translation manual.
required_to_hold_or_use.transition: The player-supplied bow is transformed into the signed quest bow, then surrendered for the translation manual.

required_to_hold_or_use.use: Colours the quest-provided bedsheet for the ghost disguise.
required_to_hold_or_use.transition: Used in the bedsheet-to-ectoplasm-bedsheet quest-item transition.

nettle_tea_route.preprepared_option: Bring one nettle tea in a bowl of water.

items: A log the player can light
make_during_quest_option.not_hard_firemaking_gate: The required log can be any log for which the player has the Firemaking level to light it; Ghosts Ahoy has no separately listed fixed Firemaking level.

nettle_tea_route.fixed_quest_use: The prepared tea is put into the Old Crone's porcelain cup and combined with the one bucket of milk.

dye_requirement.random_variable: The three model-ship flag components reveal three dye colours at the shipwreck. Each required colour may be a primary or secondary standard dye, and the three outcomes can include duplicates.
dye_requirement.fixed_use_after_reveal: Exactly one dye is applied to each of the three flag components; three required dye applications occur.
dye_requirement.conservative_preparation_bundle_not_a_ha: Three red, three yellow, and three blue dyes can be carried to make any revealed three-colour result without another dye trip. This is preparation coverage, not the deterministic amount consumed.

standard_quest_route.description: The current quest guide's listed Ecto-token route without using charter ships.

charter_ship_route.description: The current quest guide's listed Ecto-token route when using charter ships. Charter-ship coin fare is a separate variable travel choice.

token_creation_inputs.process: A bone is ground into bonemeal, a bucket is filled with slime, and the pair is worshipped at the Ectofuntus before claiming Ecto-tokens from a Ghost disciple while wearing the Ghostspeak amulet.
token_creation_inputs.container_state_limit: The registered guide specifies the required starting pots and buckets but does not provide a formal container-retention ledger. This record does not infer that pots or buckets are permanently consumed.

optional_permanent_boat_access.effect: Removes the per-trip Dragontooth Island Ecto-token fee.
optional_permanent_boat_access.classification: Optional and not required to complete Ghosts Ahoy.

coins.exact_total_is_variable: Rune-Draw losses can require additional paid rounds before the four wins. The source's approximately 400-coin figure is a preparation estimate, not a hard fixed consumption total.

required_combat.quest_requirement: One Giant lobster must be defeated during the shipwreck chest search to obtain a map scrap.
required_combat.formal_player_combat_gate: No player combat level, weapon, armour, prayer, or combat-skill requirement is listed as a formal quest gate.
required_combat.encounter_fact: The current quest guide states that the Giant lobster can be safespotted.

unlocks: Free passage through Port Phasmatys's Energy Barrier
Direct Ectophial teleport destination at the Ectofuntus outside Port Phasmatys
fixed_completion_outcomes.not_modeled: No GP, Ecto-token, or other quest-item balance is treated as a completion reward.

teleport_and_refill.activation: Emptying a full Ectophial teleports the player to the Ectofuntus outside Port Phasmatys.
teleport_and_refill.post_teleport_state: The player automatically refills it from the Ectofuntus after teleporting.
teleport_and_refill.cost: No rune, charge, or coin cost is stated for an ordinary teleport/refill cycle.
teleport_and_refill.refill_animation: The player cannot interrupt the refill animation and is immune to damage for its duration. On PvP worlds, a successful attacker can still receive experience but does no damage.
teleport_and_refill.wilderness_restriction: The teleport does not work past level 20 Wilderness.

velorina.claim_condition: Wear a Ghostspeak amulet or Morytania legs 2 or better.
velorina.replacement_when_no_ectophial_is_owned: A replacement claimed from Velorina is full.
velorina.additional_claim_when_an_ectophial_is_al: Velorina gives an empty Ectophial; it must be filled at the Ectofuntus before use.

replacement_and_duplicates.multiple_ownership: Multiple Ectophials are supported; this is why Velorina has a separate empty-duplicate outcome.

preparation_recommendations_not_hard_gat: The quest guide suggests food and weapons for the level-32 Giant lobster, but neither is a named formal entry requirement.
Level 58 Agility, which is boostable, is suggested for the Ectofuntus shortcut; it is not required for Ghosts Ahoy completion.
Stamina potions and faster travel options are guide recommendations rather than access gates.

sources.use: Quest requirements, item paths, combat encounter, rewards, and Port Phasmatys unlock.
Ectophial teleport, automatic refill, Wilderness restriction, replacement, and duplicate mechanics.

records.confidence: high for published requirements, rewards, and Ectophial mechanics; exact Rune-Draw coin expenditure and dye colours are correctly retained as variable states.
